title: LADA Blue Wings vs Night Owls, Oct 3
notes: Away game at Renton: we wore blue and had the left bench (the pipeline's defaults). The video came as 3600x1596, not Renton's usual 3840x1702, so fetch scaled it up first.

Periods, goals and shots come from the arena scoreboard (we were GUEST) and SKAHL's game sheet: periods 0:12-18:35, 20:16-38:16 and 40:00-62:52 of the video, by the clock. The clock ran without stopping in the 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd. The video runs to the final horn.

Goals at 20:27 and 29:11 of the video, both ours in the 2nd period: Semenov #54 at clock 17:50 and Charnysh #36 at 9:05 (game sheet times; the board's score changed about 12 s later). Shots from the game sheet (saves plus goals), 39-23, match the board.
The only penalty was Night Owls' Choi #98 (tripping, 3rd period, clock 4:55), our power play. No penalty kills.

Played: the 12 skaters of LADA's lineup, with sub goalie Paplinski #0. The game sheet also marks Potepalov #15 as playing, but neither the OCR nor the reviewers found his number or name, so he isn't counted. Ilinskaya #3, Potepalov #15, Babkin #26, Dukhno #50, Shipachev #88 and the subs were left out of the roster for the solve, because partial reads of 43, 53 and 35 came out as 3.

Labeled by hand: P2 row R90 (Charnysh #36, his number visible as he drove to the net for the second goal). Miroshnichenko #43's track ended mid-ice at 28:56, so the solver ran his shift on through that goal; the video shows Lisenko #55 on in his place from 28:55, so he is kept off from 28:57 (an "off" entry in periods.json). The lineup check found no gaps.

highlights.note: 2nd period, clock 17:50: scramble at their net, Semenov #54, 0-1
